purpose: Vocabulary attested in the Vietnamese lower-secondary English programme (grades 6-9) used by the RC4 vocabulary audit to recognise curriculum-level words. Only forms read in the retrieved documents are listed; nothing is inferred, expanded or translated here.
limitations: The grade 6 and grade 7 lists below are topic-level only: the retrieved teacher-training documents for those grades publish the topic list and the taught-word budget (about 200-250 words per grade) but no per-unit word table, so no word was transcribed for them.
Grade 8 and grade 9 entries were transcribed from the unit tables published for the Global Success series. Only the units that were actually read are present; the series has 12 units per grade.

A textbook word is not by itself a claim that a bank entry is worthless: an entry can teach a higher sense, a collocation or a word family of the same headword. The audit therefore reports these rows for review and never archives them automatically.
Retrieved pages are third-party reproductions of the textbooks, not the printed books. They were used for vocabulary identification only.
